title: CPF Module Schema: Web Application Firewall Policy module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-webapplicationfirewallpolicy'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

custom_rules.type: map(object({ # Required action = string priority = number rule_type = string # Optional name = optional(string) enabled = optional(bool) rate_limit_threshold = optional(number, 1) rate_limit_duration = optional(string) group_rate_limit_by = optional(string) match_conditions = map(object({ match_values = optional(list(string)) operator = string negation_condition = optional(bool) transforms = optional(list(string)) match_variables = map(object({ variable_name = string selector = optional(string) })) })) }))
custom_rules.description: (Optional) One or more custom_rules blocks as defined below. object({ name = (optional) Gets name of the resource that is unique within a policy. This name can be used to access the resource. priority = (Required) Describes priority of the rule. Rules with a lower value will be evaluated before rules with a higher value. rule_type = (Required) Describes the type of rule. Possible values are `MatchRule` and `Invalid`. action = (Required) Type of action. Possible values are `Allow`, `Block` and `Log`. enabled = (Optional) Describes if the policy is in enabled state or disabled state. Defaults to true. rate_limit_threshold = (Optional) Specifies the threshold value for the rate limit policy. Must be greater than or equal to 1 if provided. rate_limit_duration = (Optional) Specifies the duration for the rate limit policy. group_rate_limit_by = (Optional) Specifies what grouping the rate limit will count requests by. Possible values are GeoLocation, ClientAddr and None. match_condition = map(object({ match_values = (Required) A list of match values. operator = (Required) Describes operator to be matched. Possible values are IPMatch, GeoMatch, Equal, Contains, LessThan, GreaterThan, LessThanOrEqual, GreaterThanOrEqual, BeginsWith, EndsWith and Regex. negation_condition = (Required) Describes if this is negate condition or not. transforms = (Optional) A list of transformations to do before the match is attempted. Possible values are HtmlEntityDecode, Lowercase, RemoveNulls, Trim, UrlDecode and UrlEncode. })) match_variable = map(object({ variable_name = (Required) The name of the Match Variable. Possible values are RemoteAddr, RequestMethod, QueryString, PostArgs, RequestUri, RequestHeaders, RequestBody and RequestCookies. selector = (Optional) Describes field of the matchVariable collection })) )}

default_rate_limit_rule_property.type: object({ group_rate_limit_by = optional(string) match_conditions = map(object({ match_values = optional(list(string)) operator = string negation_condition = optional(bool) transforms = optional(list(string)) match_variables = map(object({ variable_name = string selector = optional(string) })) })) })
default_rate_limit_rule_property.description: (Optional) A default rate limit rule property block as defined below. object({ group_rate_limit_by = (Optional) Specifies what grouping the rate limit will count requests by. Possible values are GeoLocation, ClientAddr and None. match_condition = map(object({ match_values = (Required) A list of match values. operator = (Required) Describes operator to be matched. Possible values are IPMatch, GeoMatch, Equal, Contains, LessThan, GreaterThan, LessThanOrEqual, GreaterThanOrEqual, BeginsWith, EndsWith and Regex. negation_condition = (Required) Describes if this is negate condition or not. transforms = (Optional) A list of transformations to do before the match is attempted. Possible values are HtmlEntityDecode, Lowercase, RemoveNulls, Trim, UrlDecode and UrlEncode. })) match_variable = map(object({ variable_name = (Required) The name of the Match Variable. Possible values are RemoteAddr, RequestMethod, QueryString, PostArgs, RequestUri, RequestHeaders, RequestBody and RequestCookies. selector = (Optional) Describes field of the matchVariable collection })) )}

default_rate_limit_threshold.description: (Optional) Specifies the threshold value for the default rate limit rule.

enable_bot_manager_rules.description: (Optional) Enable or disable Bot Manager rules. When set to false, Microsoft_BotManagerRuleSet will not be applied to the WAF policy.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

exclusion.type: map(object({ match_variable = string selector = string selector_match_operator = string excluded_rule_set = object({ type = optional(string, null) version = optional(string, null) rule_group = map(object({ rule_group_name = string excluded_rules = optional(list(string), []) }), ) }) }))
exclusion.description: (Optional) an exclusion block to exclude the rules from manage rule map(object({ match_variable = (Required) The name of the Match Variable. Possible values: RequestArgKeys, RequestArgNames, RequestArgValues, RequestCookieKeys, RequestCookieNames, RequestCookieValues, RequestHeaderKeys, RequestHeaderNames, RequestHeaderValues. selector = (Required) Describes field of the matchVariable collection. selector_match_operator = (Required) Describes operator to be matched. Possible values: Contains, EndsWith, Equals, EqualsAny, StartsWith. excluded_rule_set = object({ type = (Optional) The rule set type. The only possible value include Microsoft_DefaultRuleSet and OWASP. Defaults to OWASP. version = (Optional) The rule set version. The only possible value include 2.2 (for rule set type Microsoft_DefaultRuleSet) and 3.2 (for rule set type OWASP). Defaults to 3.2. rule_group = map(object({ rule_group_name = (Required) The name of rule group for exclusion. excluded_rules = (Optional) One or more Rule IDs for exclusion. })) }) }))

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

manage_rule_set.type: map(object({ type = optional(string) version = string rule_group_override = optional(list(object({ rule_group_name = string rule = optional(list(object({ id = string enabled = optional(bool, false) action = optional(string) })), []) })), []) }))
manage_rule_set.description: (Optional) The managed_rule_set block supports the following: type = (Optional) The rule set type. Possible values: Microsoft_BotManagerRuleSet, Microsoft_DefaultRuleSet and OWASP. Defaults to OWASP. version = (Required) The rule set version. Possible values: 0.1, 1.0, 1.1, 2.1, 2.2, 2.2.9, 3.0, 3.1 and 3.2.4 rule_group_override = (Optional) List of objects: rule_group_name = (Required) The name of the rule group for override rule = (Optional) List of objects: id = (Required) Identifier for the managed rule. enabled = (Optional) Describes if the managed rule is in enabled state or disabled state. action = (Optional) Describes the override action to be applied when rule matches. Possible values are Allow, AnomalyScoring, Block and Log.

policy_settings.type: object({ enabled = optional(bool) file_upload_limit_in_mb = optional(number) max_request_body_size_in_kb = optional(number) request_body_inspect_limit_in_kb = optional(number) request_body_enforcement = optional(bool, false) file_upload_enforcement = optional(bool, true) js_challenge_cookie_expiration_in_minutes = optional(number) log_scrubbing_rule = optional(map(object({ enabled = optional(bool) match_variable = string selector_match_operator = optional(string) selector = optional(string) })), null) })
policy_settings.description: object({ enabled = (Optional) Describes if the policy is in enabled state or disabled state. Defaults to true. file_upload_limit_in_mb = (Optional) The File Upload Limit in MB. Accepted values are in the range 1 to 4000. Defaults to 100. max_request_body_size_in_kb = (Optional) The Maximum Request Body Size in KB. Accepted values are in the range 8 to 2000. Defaults to 128. request_body_inspect_limit_in_kb = (Optional) Specifies the maximum request body inspection limit in KB for the Web Application Firewall. Defaults to 128. request_body_enforcement = (Optional) Whether the firewall should block a request with body size greater then max_request_body_size_in_kb. Defaults to false. file_upload_enforcement = (Optional) Whether the firewall should block a request with upload size greater then file_upload_limit_in_mb. Defaults to true. js_challenge_cookie_expiration_in_minutes = (Optional) Specifies the JavaScript challenge cookie validity lifetime in minutes. The user is challenged after the lifetime expires. Accepted values are in the range 5 to 1440. Defaults to 30. log_scrubbing = object({ enabled = (Optional) Whether the log scrubbing is enabled or disabled. Defaults to true. scrubbing_rule = map(object({ enabled = (Optional) Whether this rule is enabled. Defaults to true. match_variable = (Required) Specifies the variable to be scrubbed from the logs. Possible values are RequestHeaderNames, RequestCookieNames, RequestArgNames, RequestPostArgNames, RequestJSONArgNames and RequestIPAddress. selector_match_operator = (Required) Specifies the variable to be scrubbed from the logs. Possible values are RequestHeaderNames, RequestCookieNames, RequestArgNames, RequestPostArgNames, RequestJSONArgNames and RequestIPAddress. selector = (Optional) Specifies which elements in the collection this rule applies to. })) }) })

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

http_listener_ids.description: A list of HTTP Listener IDs from an azurerm_application_gateway.

id.description: The ID of the created Web Application Firewall Policy.

name.description: The Name of the created Web Application Firewall Policy.

path_based_rule_ids.description: A list of URL Path Map Path Rule IDs from an azurerm_application_gateway.

resource.description: The Web Application Firewall Policy resource.
